dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents in Doi Tao District, Chiang Mai Province as of  6 October 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240912THA** This map illustrates satellite-detected water in Doi Tao District, Chiang Mai Province, Thailand, acquired on 6 October 2024 at 13:16 LT. Within the analysed area of approximately 800 km², about 54 km² of land appears to be affected by floodwaters, with around 30 km² of cropland inundated. Based on WorldPop spatial demographic data, approximately 140 people are exposed to or living near the flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
